items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: And Buddy P.T. And Buddy P.T. Punch and Buddy P.T.

ctx.x: Well different bands, didn't have no special bands to play there. But I think, what you call them, Punch used to play there all the time. And Buddy P.T. And Buddy P.T. Punch and Buddy P.T.
And Buddy P.T. It was available for clubs. You could ring, you know, whatever band you wanted. Yeah, yeah.
